name: 3D Structure-Based Molecule Generators Benchmark
description: Measures performance of 3D structure-based molecular generative models on metrics such as validity, novelty, 3D conformation accuracy, and property prediction.
typical_sota_score: validity 90–99%; novelty 60–90%; 3D RMSD ~1.0–2.5 Å (varies by task)
reputation: Moderately used in academic cheminformatics research for benchmarking 3D-aware molecular generative models but not a mainstream, standardized leaderboard.
notes: Evaluates multiple heterogeneous metrics (generation and property prediction); non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark with potential dataset size/coverage limitations and risk of training-data contamination if models were pre-trained on similar molecular sets.
